notes: Added missing stories to meet minimum and ensure full coverage (schema, logic, API, tests, integration).

SHARED-F-2-S148.title: Consent Data Schema and Tier Contract Definition
SHARED-F-2-S148.description: Define and implement the consent data model including Tier 1 (implicit/session) and Tier 2 (explicit/persistent) consent states, timestamps, audit fields, and linkage to conversation/session identifiers. Establish Pydantic models and MongoDB schema alignment for consistent validation across services.

SHARED-F-2-S149.title: Consent Core Logic Enforcement Engine
SHARED-F-2-S149.description: Implement core consent enforcement logic within ConsentService to evaluate consent tier, enforce storage permissions, trigger de-identification when required, and handle tier upgrades. Ensure all downstream services rely on this centralized logic for compliance decisions.

SHARED-F-2-S150.title: Consent-Aware Storage and De-identification Integration
SHARED-F-2-S150.description: Integrate consent enforcement with storage pathways including debug logging, unknown question recording, and lead capture. Ensure that data is either blocked, summarized, or de-identified based on consent tier before persistence.

SHARED-F-2-S151.title: Consent Framework Test Coverage (Unit and Integration)
SHARED-F-2-S151.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating consent tier behavior, storage enforcement, de-identification correctness, and cross-service interactions. Include negative cases (no consent, partial consent, upgrade flows) and ensure compliance with HIPAA Safe Harbor handling.

SHARED-F-2.mitigation: Centralize all consent decisions in ConsentService and enforce mandatory usage via service interfaces.
